terms.gloss: suck; in the obscene sense, suck the penis
evidence: Varr. ap. Non. 113.14: lac hūmānum (the plain sense) (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Properly to suck milk; Lewis & Short marks the other sense only as “obsc.”.

terms.gloss: put the penis in someone’s mouth, make someone suck it; hence abuse, treat with contempt
evidence: Catull. 28.9 (to treat in a foul or shameful manner) (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The same act from the other side. Lewis & Short gives the root sense, “to give suck”, and then only in mal. part.; the meaning follows from that and from fellō.

sources: Lewis & Short: fello · Lewis & Short: irrumo · Lewis & Short: fellator
